_published_faq.name: How do I add netlify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add netlify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://netlify-mcp.netlify.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is netlify MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, netlify scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is netlify's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, netlify scores 35/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 9 of 9 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the netlify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: netlify provides these MCP tools: netlify-coding-rules, netlify-user-services, netlify-deploy-services, netlify-team-services, netlify-project-services, and netlify-extension-services.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to netlify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to netlify in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
netlify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: How can netlify improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: get-netlify-coding-context is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 31/100. 0 of 1 inputs have descriptions. Add descriptions to the missing inputs, including where to obtain IDs and how to supply values. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
netlify is developed by Netlify. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
